00024 /* Platform specific types */
00025 typedef enum HxResult {

00032     HX_UNSUPPORTED      = DFB_UNSUPPORTED,      /**< Unsupported operation or argument */

00034     HX_ACCESS_DENIED    = DFB_ACCESSDENIED,     /**< Access to the service or resource is denied */
00035     HX_INVALID_ARG      = DFB_INVARG,           /**< Invalid argument */
00036     HX_MEMORY_ERROR     = DFB_NOSYSTEMMEMORY,   /**< Memory allocation error */
00037     HX_RESOURCE_LOCKED  = DFB_LOCKED,           /**< Locked resource */
00038     HX_BUFFER_EMPTY     = DFB_BUFFEREMPTY,      /**< Buffer is empty */
00039     HX_BUFFER_TOO_BIG   = DFB_BUFFERTOOLARGE,   /**< Buffer is too big */
00040     HX_BUSY             = DFB_BUSY,             /**< Service or resource is busy */
00041     HX_TIMEOUT          = DFB_TIMEOUT,          /**< Service timeout */
00042     HX_DESTROYED        = DFB_DESTROYED,        /**< Underlying object was destroyed */
00043     HX_INTERRUPTED      = DFB_INTERRUPTED,      /**< Operation was interrupted */
00044     HX_NO_SUCH_METHOD   = DFB_NOSUCHMETHOD,     /**< No such operation exists */
00045     HX_MISSING_FILE     = DFB_FILENOTFOUND,     /**< Needed file is missing */
00046     HX_INVAREA          = DFB_INVAREA,          /**< Invalid region */
00047     HX_SHARED_MEMORY    = DFB_NOSHAREDMEMORY,   /**< Shared memory allocation error */
00048     HX_NOT_FOUND        = DFB_ITEMNOTFOUND,     /**< Could not find the item specified */
00049     HX_INCOMPLETE       = DFB_INCOMPLETE,       /**< Resource provided is incomplete (e.g. truncated graphics file) */
00050 
00051     /* Hx errors that are not mapped to DirectFB errors */
00052     HX_NULL_POINTER     = 0x1000,               /**< Null pointer encountered */
00053     HX_BUFFER_FULL,                             /**< Buffer is full */
00054     HX_MISSING_RESOURCE,                        /**< Specified resource does not exist */
00055     HX_RESOURCE_EXISTS,                         /**< Singleton, this resource already exists */
00056     HX_RESOURCE_TOO_BIG,                        /**< Resource is too big for the operation */

00058     HX_WRONG_TYPE,                              /**< Wrong data type used */
00059     HX_WRONG_LISTENER_TYPE,                     /**< Wrong message listener type defined */
00060     HX_ALREADY_REGISTERED,                      /**< Resource or ID already registered */
00061     HX_NOT_REGISTERED,                          /**< Resource or ID is not registered */
00062     HX_INVALID_BOUNDS,                          /**< Invalid bounds */
00063     HX_MAX_LIMIT_REACHED,                       /**< Max limit of entries in API reached */
00064     HX_READ_ONLY_VALUE,                         /**< Read-only value */
00065     HX_OPEN_FAILED,                             /**< Failed to open file, device... */
00066     HX_UNINITIALIZED,                           /**< Some required operation not yet performed */
00067     HX_DISABLED,                                /**< Service or function disabled */
00068     HX_TOOL_ERROR,                              /**< Generic tool error */
00069     HX_SOUND_ERROR,                             /**< Problems with the sound system */
00070 
00071     HX_ITER_EXCEED,                             /**< An iterator has run off the end of list */
00072     HX_DUPLICATE,                               /**< attempt to install something that's already installed */
00073     HX_USER_CANCEL,                             /**< user cancelled, e.g. a password dialog */
00074 
00075     /* Hx errors that are specific to the property subsystem */
00076     HX_PROPERTY_NOT_FOUND        = 0x2000,      /**< Property with given ID not found */
00077     HX_PROPERTY_WRONG_TYPE,                     /**< Wrong data type for property used */
00078     HX_PROPERTY_DOMAIN_NOT_REGISTERED,          /**< Domain is not registered */
00079     HX_PROPERTY_READ_ONLY_VALUE,                /**< Property Read-only value */

00082 
00083     HX_NOT_USER,                                /**< Caller can't be root */
00084     HX_PASSWD_WRONG,                            /**< Provided password is wrong */
00085     HX_GLOBAL_KEY_UNAVAIL,                      /**< Unable to create or decrypt global key; need user to enter passwd? */
00086 
00087     HX_FILETYPE_UNKNOWN,                        /**< Unable to determine type of file (e.g. to know what app to launch for it) */
00088     HX_PROPERTY_WRITE_ONLY_VALUE,               /**< Property Write-only value */
00089     /**
00090      * @brief  Return value for event callbacks if the callback has handled
00091      * the event, and if the event should not be passed on to the default 
00092      * system handler.  Callbacks should return DFB_OK only if the event is  
00093      * not handled, and if the event should be passed on to the default
00094      * system handler.
00095      *
00096      **/
00097     HX_EVENT_HANDLED    = 0x8000,
00098 
00099     HX_MAX_ERROR_CODE = -1                      /**< Used to force enum to be a signed int */
00100 } HxResult;
